messages:
Meera: Heads-up — our Thursday RFC review appears to have duplicate invites in GCal. Two recurrences showing up for the same event, and Zoom shows a different recurrence-id on one. Anyone else seeing this?
Ben: Yep, I got 2 invites. One resolves to 09:00 PT and another to 17:00 PT on my calendar. I'm on BST so it's a mess.
Ollie: Same here from APAC — one of them floats to 02:00 my time. I assumed daylight savings but doesn't add up.
Kate: Can you paste the ICS export? if it's got two RRULEs that's probably the culprit.
Meera: Pasting the snippet I exported from the event:
```
BEGIN:VEVENT
UID:evt-12345
RRULE:FREQ=WEEKLY;BYDAY=TH;COUNT=10
RRULE:FREQ=WEEKLY;BYDAY=TH;UNTIL=20260701T000000Z
X-ZOOM-RECURRENCE-ID:2026-05-20T16:00:00Z
END:VEVENT
```
Ben: Ugh, duplicate RRULEs + mismatched UID. I've seen this before when someone edits recurrence from Google UI + the calendar syncer rewrites the exported ICS.
calendar-bot: calendar-bot: Event updated by Meera (recurrence changed).
Sam: Is this the same recurrence-id bug from last quarter where the export layer didn't collapse edits? cc @Ben
Ben: Probably. Workaround we used: delete and recreate the recurring series (annoying but cleans the ICS). Downside: loses past-instance metadata.
Meera: For this week's RFC: propose we skip the live meeting (async review) and only run a single live session next week with a rotating timezone. Quick check — react with :thumbsup: if 16:00 PT this Thu would work, :thumbsdown: if not.
Ollie: :thumbsup: but prefer rotating schedule so same folks don't always get the late slot. Single-use Zoom link + pinned agenda doc would help too.
Kate: Agree. I'll open a ticket for infra to look at calendar syncer (CAL-73) and include the ICS snippet.
Ben: I'll spin up a quick Doodle poll for rotation options: https://doodle.com/poll/abcd1234 
Meera: Thanks. Action items: Ben — create poll; Kate — file calendar sync ticket; Sam — if we keep weekly I'll re-create the series cleanly; otherwise I'll send a one-off invite for this week. Please add async comments to the RFC doc: https://redwood.my/docs/rfc-xyz
deploy-bot: deploy-bot: Reminder: weekly notification for 'eng-rfc-review' scheduled 2026-05-20 16:00:00 PT
Kate: For the record, the root cause looks like UID mismatch + duplicate RRULE in the export. Avoid editing the existing recurrence until infra patches the exporter.
Meera: Sweet — appreciate the quick responses. I'll post the final call after the poll. :pray:
